sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - P226R is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Oh, hey. I've got an unusual request this time. I don't often get orders for sidearms, but this is a special case. Bring me a SIG P226R with a Stainless Elite Wooden grip, a Stainless Elite slide, an extended magazine, and a flashlight. Ergonomics no lower than 77, combined recoil no higher than 610. A weapon for true enthusiasts."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify a P226R to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Finished? Thanks for your help. I might have to add one of these to my own collection..."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
P226R specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 610 or less recoil
- 77 or more ergonomics
- P226 Stainless Elite pistol slide
- P226 Stainless Elite Wooden pistol grip
- P226 9x19 20-round extended magazine
- Any tactical device (such as the NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser)

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard P226R from Peacekeeper LL1.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
